issues.display_title: Issue #1: Redesign GoThru Photo Viewer App based on Maptrails App
issues.main_description_html:
Repo: https://github.com/GoThruMedia/GoThruPhotoViewer

Branch: 202606101444-redesign_app

Context

Full visual and interaction overhaul inspired by Maptrails (native iOS hiking app — see design.md). The design principle is "content is hero, chrome steps back": the panorama/map/camera fills the screen; UI controls appear when needed and recede when not.
